美国中期选举前夜民主党距多数仅差4席

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据 CNN 报道，美国中期选举前夜，民主党已逼近夺回参议院多数，但多个关键席位仍处胶着，深红州仍可能向任一党倾斜。CNN 将「最可能翻盘」名单扩至 11 席，新增南卡罗来纳，得克萨斯、堪萨斯等年初几乎无人看好的战场排序上移。民主党需翻转 4 个共和党现任席位，并守住全部本党席位，才能拿下参议院多数。

报道称，CNN 民调汇总显示特朗普支持率约 34%，经济、伊朗战争与腐败议题正推升民主党动员。最终一个月，共和党在上述 11 场选举广告投放约 5.6 亿美元，民主党约 5.21 亿美元；若剔除佐治亚与北卡，共和党优势更大。排名前段包括：北卡罗来纳民主党人 Roy Cooper 在 High Point/YouGov 终局民调中领先共和党 Michael Whatley 约 14 个百分点，被列为最可能翻盘席位；俄亥俄前参议员 Sherrod Brown 平均领先约 5 个百分点；得州 James Talarico 对阵 Ken Paxton，CNN 汇总暂无明确领先者，但近日《纽约时报》/Siena 与 CNN 民调显示 Talarico 领先，马斯克相关支出约占共和党该州广告逾 1.68 亿美元。名单其余依次为缅因、阿拉斯加、堪萨斯、艾奥瓦、密歇根、新罕布什尔、南卡与佐治亚等。

【Elliptic：币安黑客已通过约 1.2 万个钱包洗钱，约 32.4 亿美元仍留存于相关地址】

Foresight News 消息，据 Elliptic 分析，币安黑客在不到 4 天内动用 11 条区块链上的约 1.2 万个钱包、发起超过 4 万笔交易进行洗钱，整个过程明显为自动化操作。在被盗的 64.3 亿美元资产中，已有 28.5 亿美元被冻结或查扣，约占 44%；约 32.4 亿美元仍留在与被盗相关的地址中，以 ETH 和 BTC 为主，目前可能仅有极少量已被变现。从洗钱路径来看，Tron 是目前的主要通道：资金先被分散至约 7700 个地址，再通过跨链桥转至以太坊，转出金额至少 1.47 亿美元。自 11 月 1 日起，ETH、SOL、NEAR 和 XRP 也开始移动，其中 2.33 亿枚 XRP 已于 11 月 2 日全部转入 6 个新地址；黑客窃取的 18,270 枚 BTC 在事发当天被拆分至 19 个地址后，至今未动。此外，约 28 枚 BTC（约 220 万美元）已进入 Wasabi 钱包等使用的 CoinJoin 混币交易，这是被盗资金首次被混币；另有约 1600 万美元转入了同样存有 9 月 Bitget 被盗资金的地址。Elliptic 预计，参照 Bybit 被盗案的模式，黑客将分多笔把 ETH 换成 BTC，再在数月内通过场外（OTC）经纪商和交易所变现。

香港金管局推出SAGE项目，成立代理式金融专家小组

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据香港金融管理局公告，金管局今日宣布推出 SAGE 项目，全称为 Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement，意即「结合管治与赋能，构建安全可靠的代理式金融」，旨在推动代理式金融在香港的负责任发展及应用，并同步成立代理式金融专家小组汇聚业界意见。

金管局指出，随着代理式人工智能技术日趋成熟，金融业在推进内部采用的同时，正进一步探索人工智能代理如何使金融服务更有效率和安全。SAGE 项目将聚焦四个主要范畴：一是市场发展及应用场景探索，支持市场参与者验证解决方案，潜在方向包括企业对消费者（B2C）的代理式购物及日常支付、企业对企业（B2B）的采购及财资管理，以及机器对机器（M2M）按用量支付数字服务费用；二是代理身分，探讨核实人工智能代理身分及获授权限的方法，包括「认识你的代理（KYA）」措施及身分认证机制；三是互通性标准，促进业界就相关标准及协议的讨论，以支持生态内安全畅顺互动；四是法律及监管框架，就管治安排、法律责任及消费者保障等议题交流意见。

为汇聚专业知识和观点，金管局成立代理式金融专家小组支持 SAGE 项目，成员包括金融机构、科技服务提供商、专业服务机构及学术界等持份者。金管局总裁余伟文表示，代理式金融具重塑金融服务提供和使用方式的潜力，希望透过一系列措施并促进与业界专家交流，在推动创新的同时巩固香港在下一代金融科技领域的领先地位，确保代理式金融符合用户最佳利益并维持金融体系稳定。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?
Bitcoin lost 7.3% in October 2026 after another decline the previous year, despite the month’s historically strong returns, as analysts reassess seasonal signals.
Bitcoin’s back-to-back October losses have put its “Uptober” reputation under the microscope as analysts weigh seasonal trends against institutional demand and economic conditions.
Bitcoin fell 7.3% in October 2026, following a roughly 4% decline a year earlier, according to CoinGlass data.
The losses defied October’s historically bullish reputation, which earned it the nickname “Uptober.” This year, industry figures turned to darker labels, including “Black October” and “Hacktober,” amid a wave of crypto security incidents, including Binance’s record-breaking $6.3 billion hack.
Bitcoin’s seasonal trends shift as monthly volatility declines
October has historically delivered Bitcoin’s highest median return at 15.4%, with gains in 10 of 13 years through 2025, according to Andrew Yang, a researcher at crypto analytics firm Kaiko.
September’s historically bearish reputation has weakened as well. Bitcoin has posted gains every September since 2023, which could reflect traders buying ahead of an expected October rally, Yang told Cointelegraph.
Bitcoin’s narrowing price swings may also be making seasonal trends less pronounced, Yang said. Its typical monthly move has declined from 14% between 2013 and 2016 to 9.6% since 2024, leaving less room for sharp seasonal rallies, he added.
Are institutions rewriting Bitcoin’s calendar?
Analysts also pointed to institutional investment and broader economic conditions as increasingly important influences on Bitcoin’s price.
Justin d’Anethan, head of research at Arctic Digital, pointed to exchange-traded fund (ETF) flows and corporate Bitcoin buyers, saying their investment decisions are shaped more by liquidity, interest rates and investment mandates than seasonal trading narratives.
Related: Bitcoin ETF flows give mixed read on institutional demand: CoinShares
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $515 million in net outflows in October, while spot Ether ETFs saw a record $1.61 billion in monthly withdrawals.
Yang cautioned that spot Bitcoin ETFs, approved in January 2024, are too recent to assess. Still, Bitcoin “increasingly trades like a macro asset, driven more by economic data and institutional flows than by the calendar,” he said.
Two October losses don’t settle the question
Despite two consecutive October losses, analysts cautioned against writing off Uptober entirely.
Julio Moreno, head of research at CryptoQuant, said October has generally performed better during Bitcoin bull markets and worse during bear markets, making the broader market cycle an important factor when comparing returns.
“Price performance depends more on spot demand dynamics than cyclical patterns, and demand doesn’t care about the calendar,” Moreno told Cointelegraph.
Related: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
Markus Levin, co-founder of XYO, said that traders may be anticipating seasonal gains earlier. “When enough people expect a rally in October, the rally gets priced in before the month arrives,” he said.
“Uptober has historical validity but, like other seasonality metrics, it can also fail at times,” said Arctic Digital’s d’Anethan.
Magazine: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
items.title: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?

腾讯Hyra 2.0迈向AI自主科研：从头训练模型、设计机器人，甚至参与研发下一代AI

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯混元发布科研 Agent Hyra 2.0，将研究重点从针对单个难题反复试错，扩展到研发能够长期复用的科学模型、算法和工具。

为了让 AI 持续开展数天甚至数周的研究，Hyra 2.0 将工作分给 Overall、Mission、Worker 三层 Agent，分别负责资源协调、研究规划和实验执行。任务会持久化保存，等待训练结果时也能推进其他研究。每项结论需要附上代码、日志等证据，必要时交给独立 Agent 复核。有效经验还会沉淀成 Skill，供后续任务使用。

腾讯披露，Hyra 2.0 已经从头训练出两款蛋白质模型。其中，196 万参数的 HyInv 能根据目标骨架设计蛋白质序列，生成速度比常用的 ProteinMPNN 快 57 倍。在单张 H20 GPU 的预热测试中，生成 128 条约 400 个残基的序列只需约 50 毫秒。另一款 HyPLM-Flash 有 6.5 亿参数，使用了 7260 亿训练 token。两款模型的权重、推理代码和技术报告均已公开。

Hyra 2.0 还参与优化开源 RISC-V 处理器「香山」，使 SPEC CPU2006 每 GHz 性能提高 5.79%，芯片面积仅增加 0.3%。

它还设计了一只五根手指长短递增的「旋梯手」。这只手最初比原有最优设计慢约 11%，但经过相同预算的控制算法训练后，仿真旋转速度反而快了 28.6%。

目前，Hyra 2.0 也已参与下一代混元模型的预训练、后训练及推理系统优化，尝试让 AI 通过改进研发工具，帮助训练出更强的下一代 AI。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.
Hardware wallet maker Trezor has increased the maximum length of optional wallet passphrases from 50 to 128 characters.
On Sunday, Trezor said the change is available in its Trezor Suite with updated device firmware. Older firmware still limits passphrases to 50 characters.
According to Trezor, a passphrase acts like an additional password that users set alongside their wallet’s recovery phrase. An attacker who obtains the recovery phrase would still need the correct passphrase to access funds in that wallet.
Trezor cited the Coldcard attacks in July, when a firmware flaw caused some devices to generate recovery phrases with insufficient randomness, allowing attackers to reconstruct them. Trezor said strong, unique passphrases protected some affected users.
The update follows a separate warning involving Trezor’s own devices.
On Friday, the company advised customers who bought wallets from former authorized reseller CryptoBilis since March to move their funds to new wallets.
An Indonesian customer reported a suspected implant inside a Trezor Safe 5 that could capture on-screen information, including recovery phrases, and transmit it over a cellular network. Trezor said Friday it had not examined the device and had received no reports of related losses.
Related: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack

items.ai_summary: The FBI attributed last week's $6B Binance theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor group and released hundreds of associated addresses, while Binance restored withdrawals, processing $4.65B in outflows and $1.01B in deposits in under ten hours and reopening fiat withdrawals including USD.
items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- The FBI said North Korea's TraderTraitor was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, and published hundreds of addresses linked to the hack.
- Binance began restoring withdrawals on Sunday, processing $4.65 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits in the first nine and a half hours.
- The exchange said the net outflow represented 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets, and it has since reopened fiat withdrawals, including U.S. dollars.
The FBI has confirmed that North Korea was behind last week's theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, as the exchange began reopening withdrawals and reported billions of dollars leaving the platform.
In an alert published on Saturday, the FBI said the attack was carried out by North Korean hackers it refers to as "TraderTraitor," confirming the attribution blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis made on Friday.
The FBI is releasing information advising the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, on or about October 29, 2026. The FBI refers to this specific North… pic.twitter.com/TBUvUFln4n
— FBI Cyber Branch (@FBICyberBranch) October 31, 2026
The FBI, together with the Secret Service and IRS Criminal Investigation, has seen the hackers converting stolen assets mainly into Ethereum, and expects them to launder the funds further through DeFi and instant swap services, the bureau said. It urged node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other crypto businesses to block transactions involving hundreds of Ethereum addresses, 19 Bitcoin addresses and one Solana address it linked to the theft.
The Secret Service, which is also investigating the theft, said on Sunday that its investigators worked with industry partners to identify and freeze "a significant portion" of the stolen crypto within minutes of the attack. That work continues with the FBI, IRS Criminal Investigation, the U.S. Attorney's Offices for Washington, D.C. and the Central District of California, and the Justice Department's computer crime and national security divisions, the agency said.
The laundering is already well underway. After the attack, the hackers moved more than $500 million on Tron through more than 1,000 addresses, over 3,000 deposits and several Tron-based DeFi protocols, blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis said on Sunday. Most of those staging wallets have now been drained, with funds leaving Tron through cross-chain services including Chainflip, Relay, THORChain and NEAR for dozens of fresh wallets on Ethereum, Bitcoin and other chains, and the launderers have started moving onto Solana, the firm said.
Withdrawals resume
Binance began restoring withdrawals in phases at 1 a.m. ET on Sunday, and all 15 networks and assets in its first phase were available by 7:36 a.m. ET. In the first nine and a half hours, it processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits, a net outflow of about $3.64 billion, the exchange said.
That represents 2.1% of the $171 billion in assets Binance reported in its most recent proof of reserves, from October 28, according to the exchange. "After an initial spike, withdrawal volumes have declined and are stabilising as expected," Binance said. It took a new reserves snapshot on October 31 and expects to publish an updated report on Monday.
As withdrawals began, CEO Richard Teng said Binance had replenished approximately 95% of the affected assets. "Binance will absorb the financial impact of the stolen funds, not our users," he wrote.
Today, we're beginning the phased resumption of withdrawals, taking a careful approach to ensure services return safely and securely.
We've now replenished approximately 95% of the impacted assets, and our commitment remains clear: Binance will absorb the financial impact of the… https://t.co/wKvI7Q4fsT pic.twitter.com/uWFGs3sJJ5
— Richard Teng (@_RichardTeng) November 1, 2026
Binance has since reopened withdrawals on more networks, including Zcash, TON and Sui, and on Monday restored fiat withdrawals in U.S. dollars, UAE dirhams, Vietnamese dong, Philippine pesos and Indonesian rupiah.
"Our top priority right now is to ensure the environment is secure, after which users can withdraw their funds and Binance can resume operations," Binance co-CEO Yi He said on X on Monday, Reuters reported. Binance said it has raised $6 billion to cover the losses from its corporate treasury, an insurance fund and its SAFU emergency fund, according to Reuters, which also reported that Circle had frozen more than $1.1 billion in USDC.
Data from DefiLlama, which tracks the public wallets of exchanges, put Binance's total assets at about $127.6 billion on Monday. More than $6 billion left wallets associated with Binance over 24 hours after withdrawals reopened, CoinDesk reported, citing DefiLlama, though those movements can include transfers between Binance's own wallets. Rival exchanges OKX and Bybit recorded net inflows of about $450 million and $134 million, respectively, during Binance's reopening.
The hack has also rattled institutional investors. Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $643.2 million on Friday, the first full trading session after the hack, leaving the funds with roughly $516 million in net outflows for October. "A hack at a crypto exchange is bank robbery at the speed of the internet," TRM Labs' Ari Redbord told Reuters.

瑞银：市场低估AI周期持续时间，2027年或迎投入回报拐点

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据彭博社报道，瑞银首席欧洲股票策略师兼衍生品负责人 Gerry Fowler 表示，市场低估了 AI 周期的持续时间，AI 交易仍然稳健。他指出，一些超大规模云厂商的估值倍数已低于 20 倍，而营收仍每年增长 10% 至 20%，反映市场预期相当悲观，因此仍有不少投资者愿意重新买入 AI 相关资产。

Fowler 认为，巨额 AI 支出可能接近开始产生回报的阶段，2027 年或出现潜在拐点：数据中心交付有望释放积压订单，推动收入逐渐赶上资本开支。他表示，现金并未从市场消失，而是转移至存储芯片制造商等供应商，后者正开始向投资者返还现金。市场对存储芯片企业的定价，也反映了他认为过短的 AI 周期。

对于下一阶段受益者，Fowler 更关注帮助建设新工厂的全球及欧洲工业企业。他指出，许多电缆、电力设备等基础设施供应商的订单已排至 2027 年甚至 2028 年，盈利预测进一步上修的空间有限。ASML 则通过向三星电子、SK 海力士等扩产的存储厂商供应设备受益，而非直接供应数据中心；他表示，ASML 及欧洲部分工业企业正获得预期上修。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，香港金管局宣布，EnsembleTX 项目进入新阶段，支持全天候 24/7 真实价值代币化交易结算，帮助银行及客户在传统结算时段之外进行全球资金调拨、代币化投资管理及财资运作。金管局总裁余伟文表示，正引入代币化央行货币，作为全天候结算的「基础层」。金管局表示，认可交易商已完成代币化外汇基金票据的二级市场试验交易，下一步计划将受监管稳定币纳入相关试验。

另据汇丰集团 CEO Georges Elhedery 在香港金融科技周披露，港元稳定币 RedCoin 推出约 10 天，用户数已达 5 万，目标拓展至数百万用户。RedCoin 于 10 月 23 日在 PayMe 推出，支持转账及商户付款，超过 330 万名 PayMe 客户可开通稳定币钱包使用。汇丰还计划将其接入手机银行，并支持认购代币化投资产品，包括港元货币市场基金份额。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.
Hong Kong has expanded its Project Ensemble pilot to allow round-the-clock settlement of tokenized transactions, as the city’s monetary regulator prepares to bring regulated stablecoins into trials involving tokenized government debt.
On Monday, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said that it had advanced its EnsembleTX project to a new stage allowing 24/7 real-value transactions. The HKMA said the update would help banks and their clients move funds globally, manage tokenized investments and handle treasury operations outside conventional settlement hours.
Participating banks initially settled payments through Hong Kong’s existing dollar settlement system, which limited settlement hours. When the pilot began real-value trials in November 2025, the HKMA said it planned to introduce tokenized central bank money to allow settlement around the clock.
The HKMA launched Project Ensemble in March 2024 to explore how banks could settle tokenized transactions using wholesale central bank digital money. A sandbox opened that August, allowing banks to connect their tokenized deposit platforms and test transactions.
Speaking at Hong Kong FinTech Week on Monday, HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue said the regulator was introducing tokenized central bank money as a “foundation layer” for 24/7 settlement. He said tokenized bonds, money market funds and bank deposits were already being used.
The HKMA also said recognized dealers had completed secondary-market trial trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills, a form of short-term debt issued by the regulator. It plans to expand those trials to include regulated stablecoins.
HSBC’s RedCoin reaches 50,000 users
Separately, HSBC Group CEO Georges Elhedery said at Hong Kong FinTech Week that the bank’s recently launched Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, RedCoin, had reached 50,000 users about 10 days after its debut.
“We have 50,000 users,” Elhedery said, adding that HSBC was targeting “multi-million users” as it expands access to the token.
RedCoin’s rollout brings stablecoins to retail payments, while Ensemble’s settlement work has focused on transactions involving banks and tokenized investments.
Elhedery said HSBC was also offering tokenized deposits to wholesale clients in Hong Kong and about half a dozen other jurisdictions, allowing funds to move around the clock.
Related: Hong Kong prepares banks for quantum threats amid tokenization push
The bank launched RedCoin on Oct. 23 for transfers and merchant payments through its PayMe application. HSBC said more than 3.3 million PayMe customers could activate stablecoin wallets to use the token. It also plans to bring the stablecoin into its mobile banking app and allow subscriptions to tokenized investments, including a Hong Kong dollar money market fund share class.
HSBC was among Hong Kong’s first licensed stablecoin issuers in April alongside Anchorpoint Financial, a venture backed by Animoca Brands and Standard Chartered. The city’s licensing regime, introduced in August 2025, requires issuers to meet standards for backing reserves, redemption and risk management.

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，美国参议院民主党人指责马斯克旗下社交媒体平台 X 对预测市场 Polymarket 给予优待。内华达州民主党参议员 Catherine Cortez Masto、加利福尼亚州民主党参议员 Adam Schiff、内华达州民主党参议员 Jacky Rosen 以及康涅狄格州民主党参议员 Richard Blumenthal 在一封由 Semafor 率先披露的联名信中写道：「通常情况下，X 允许用户以多种理由举报广告。然而，当用户通过 X 的标准界面尝试举报 Polymarket 的广告时，却无法选择举报选项。其他类型的广告，包括 Kalshi 的广告，则不存在这一问题。」

items.content:
BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
Bitcoin price action held its 100-day moving average into the monthly close as crypto markets braced for US midterm election and tech earnings volatility.
Bitcoin (BTC) held above its 100-day moving average on Monday ahead of US midterm elections, jobs data and earnings from Apple and Palantir.
Key points:
- Kalshi traders put Democrats’ chances of winning control of the House at 93.6% ahead of Tuesday’s US midterm elections.
- US nonfarm payrolls are forecast to rise by 65,000 in October as markets favor a December Fed rate hike.
- Bitcoin holds its 100-day moving average as trader Rekt Capital compares its price chart with the 2023 recovery.
Midterms follow Bitcoin’s weakest October since 2014
Tuesday’s US midterm elections will determine control of Congress, with prediction market traders heavily favoring a Democratic victory in the House of Representatives.
Kalshi put the probability of Democrats winning the House at 93.6% as of Monday.
President Donald Trump said he would use his veto power if Democrats took control of Congress.
“I guess I’ll become Mr Veto. They’ll be sending stuff up. You veto it,” he said, according to the New York Post.
US midterm elections odds (screenshot). Source: Kalshi
Bitcoin ended the fourth quarter lower in each of the past three US midterm election years, falling 17.3% in 2014, 43.5% in 2018 and 14.8% in 2022. All three periods coincided with Bitcoin bear markets.
Benjamin Cowen, founder and CEO of crypto analytics platform IntoTheCryptoverse, suggested that the midterms can function as a cue to increase BTC exposure due to their short-term bearish impact on price.
“Usually the Q4 dump of midterm years just provide opportunities to buy for those who sold long ago,” he said Friday on X.
In July, Cowen referenced Bitcoin bear-market bottoms coinciding with the second half of midterm years.
BTC/USD was down 6.4% for the quarter as of Monday, after its weakest October since 2014, according to CoinGlass.
BTC/USD liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass
Jobs data and tech earnings test market expectations
September US job openings data are due Tuesday, followed by October’s nonfarm payrolls report on Friday.
Payrolls are expected to rise by 65,000, after the economy added 29,000 jobs in September, below forecasts for 84,000. Such an outcome notionally increases the odds of dovish policy signals from the Federal Reserve, which is in turn bullish for crypto and risk-asset liquidity.
Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Fed Governor Michelle Bowman are among the officials due to speak this week.
Data from CME Group’s FedWatch Tool currently shows that markets expect the Fed to raise interest rates by 0.25 percentage points at the December meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The odds of such an outcome have sat between 67% and 75% for the past month.
Fed target rate probability comparison for December FOMC meeting (screenshot). Source: CME Group
The University of Michigan will also release its preliminary November consumer sentiment survey on Friday, including consumers’ inflation expectations.
Alongside the macro data prints, 20% of S&P 500 companies are due to report earnings in the coming days. Chief among these are tech giants Apple and Palantir, both due to report after the market close on Monday.
The reports follow last week’s tech sell-off, when disappointing guidance renewed concerns about AI spending and profitability.
Economist Mohamed El-Erian described markets as now “acutely sensitive” to tech-sector news headlines in weekend analysis.
“The market is particularly focused on justification for the massive capital expenditures being deployed across the sector, ROI’s, and revenue growth,” he wrote.
Bitcoin chart draws comparisons with 2023 recovery
After closing October down 7.3%, Bitcoin is holding above a moving average that has provided support since mid-August.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
TradingView data showed BTC/USD staying above last week’s low near $76,300, without retesting it around the monthly close.
That low was close to the 100-day simple moving average (SMA) for BTC/USD, which has since risen to $76,548.
Bitcoin also reclaimed its 100-week exponential moving average (EMA) in time for the monthly close, with this standing at $77,759.
BTC/USD daily chart with 100 SMA, 100 EMA. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Trader and analyst Rekt Capital compared the weekly chart with Bitcoin’s rebound from its 2022 bear market low. During the recovery, BTC/USD produced an inverse head-and-shoulders pattern, retested support at the right shoulder, briefly fell below it and then rallied.
Last week’s drop to $76,300 brought Bitcoin back to what Rekt Capital identified as right-shoulder support on the current chart. He is watching for a brief move below that level as a possible next step in the comparison.
“The question now is whether Bitcoin can produce some sort of downside deviation below here over the next few weeks,” Rekt Capital said.
BTC/USD one-week chart. Source: Rekt Capital on X.com
items.title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B
OKX led cryptocurrency exchanges with $445 million in daily inflows, while Binance processed about $7 billion in net outflows.
OKX recorded about $445 million in 24-hour net inflows, the largest among tracked crypto exchanges, while Binance continued to register outflows after reopening withdrawals following its $6.3 billion hack.
Crypto exchange Bybit was in second place with $112 million in net inflows, followed by Gate with $91 million and Bitget with $54 million in 24-hour net inflows, according to DefiLlama.
Binance recorded the biggest net outflows among tracked exchanges, with more than $7 billion, up from $5.8 billion earlier Monday. Binance said it began restoring withdrawals in phases at 6:00 a.m. UTC on Sunday.
At the time of writing, Binance held about $127.9 billion in wallets tracked by DefiLlama, more than four times the $29 billion at OKX, the second-largest exchange by that measure.
Binance suspended withdrawals Friday, soon after late Thursday’s $6.3 billion hack, the largest in cryptocurrency history.
By Sunday, Binance said it had replenished approximately 95% of the affected assets, up from 90% on Saturday. The remaining 5% consisted of less liquid tokens that it continued to buy through market and over-the-counter transactions.
The exchange is using its corporate treasury, a partial deployment of its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) and a portion of its futures insurance fund to replace the stolen assets. Binance has pledged to absorb the losses without passing them on to customers.
About $3 billion in stolen assets frozen by industry partners is separate from Binance’s replacement funds. Binance said Sunday it published a new reserves snapshot and an updated proof-of-reserves report was expected Monday.
OKX’s OKB token rose about 1.4% over the past 24 hours to trade near $113 on Monday, while BNB gained 0.3% to about $708 over the same period, according to CoinMarketCap.
Related: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack

阿里云推出Qovest：99元/月起，给投资者配个「超级投研助手」

动察 Beating AI 快讯，阿里云发布 AI 投研工作台 Qovest，面向专业投资者。用户只需提出研究需求，它就能自动查询金融数据、搜集财报资料、拆解产业链、测算投资规模，最终生成研究报告。

比如，研究人形机器人产业链，它能拆解各环节的单机价值和国产化水平，生成可交互的产业链图谱。研究数据中心电力设施，只需修改一个前提假设，相关测算就能自动更新。

Qovest 还提供「投研空间」，可以保存历史研究成果、操盘笔记和待验证问题，让用户不必每次都从头开始研究。它还支持定时追踪市场变化。用户可以为黄金 ETF 设置每周研究任务，让 AI 定期更新国际金价、美元指数、ETF 持仓和央行购金等数据，并生成动态分析看板。

为了提高金融研究的准确性，阿里云采购了专业金融数据库，并自研金融 Agent 执行框架，打通数据调用、分析和报告生成流程。官方称，Qovest 在 FinFIRST 和 iRaB 两套金融评测集的内部横评中，回答质量、响应速度和成本均领先，但尚未公开具体成绩和测试配置。

目前 Qovest 已面向个人用户开放邀测，注册可领取积分免费试用，后续提供每月 99 元和 199 元两档订阅套餐。面向金融机构的企业版也计划近期推出。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.
Investors pulled $643 million from US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) on Friday, pushing October’s net flows into negative territory as crypto markets faced volatility following Binance’s $6.3 billion hack.
Friday’s withdrawals snapped four consecutive days of inflows, leaving the funds with $515 million in net outflows for October, their first negative month since June, according to SoSoValue. The funds still attracted approximately $361 million in net inflows for the year through October.
BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) led Friday’s outflows with $234 million, followed by Fidelity’s Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) with $201 million, according to Farside Investors data.
The withdrawals followed Bitcoin’s drop to $77,000 on Thursday. Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange by trading volume, confirmed Friday that hackers had stolen about $6.3 billion in crypto assets.
Hardware wallet maker OneKey’s founder and CEO, Yishi, warned on X Friday that IBIT could face similar security threats because it relies heavily on Coinbase to hold its Bitcoin.
Investors also withdrew a net $156 million from US spot Ether (ETH) ETFs on Friday, bringing October’s net outflows to a record $1.61 billion. The previous monthly high was $1.42 billion in November 2025.
October’s withdrawals also erased the Ether funds’ net inflows for 2026, leaving them with roughly $45 million in net outflows for the year.
Related: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold

中期选举BTC表现复盘：市场底部多在选举前后，历次选后一年涨幅可观

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，美国中期选举将于 11 月 3 日举行。回顾过往选举期间的加密市场表现，比特币呈现「选举年偏弱、选后一年回升」的特征。据 HTX 行情信息，2014、2018、2022 年三次中期选举后的 12 个月内，比特币分别上涨约 24.5%、44.9% 和 92.3%。

与此同时，中期选举当年全年多为熊市，比特币 2014 年全年下跌约 56%、2018 年约 73%、2022 年约 64%。同年第四季度也多为负收益，2014 年 Q4 约-16.7%、2018 年约-42%、2022 年约-14.8%。短期波动更为剧烈，例如 2018 年选后一个月曾大跌约 45.5%，随后才逐步反弹。市场底部往往出现在选举前后，2014 年为中选后约 71 天、2018 年后约 38 天、2022 年后约 13 天。

值得注意的是，中期选举与比特币传统四年周期高度重合，与中选本身相比，宏观流动性与周期位置影响更大，历史样本有限，不宜简单线性外推。

本次中期选举美国选民将改选全部 435 个众议院席位、35 个参议院席位以及多个州长职位，直接决定特朗普剩余两年任期内国会由谁控制。共和党目前以微弱优势掌控两院（众议院约 218-214，参议院 53-47），但特朗普支持率已跌至约 32% 左右的历史低位，通胀、伊朗战争、关税政策等因素引发选民不满，民调普遍显示民主党在全国范围领先，预测模型大多认为民主党有较大概率拿下众议院，参议院则处于胶着状态。共和党正全力守住多数席位，但历史规律显示执政党在中期选举中往往失利。

items.content:
白宫六巨头开吐槽大会：马斯克骂OpenAI不要脸，黄仁勋吐槽坐飞机没网

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 8 日，黄仁勋、马斯克、谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林、微软 CEO 纳德拉、AMD 苏姿丰和戴尔创始人迈克尔·戴尔，在华盛顿参加特朗普的国家科学与技术奖章颁奖仪式。

《Colossus》记者 Harry Lambert 记录下这群科技巨头在白宫后台的一场私下闲聊，内容相当精彩：

马斯克是最后到场的，也是唯一没有接受安检的嘉宾。他带着母亲和三个孩子，一进房间便四处张望，兴奋得像个少年。现场有美国能源部长、NASA 局长，还有好几位全球顶级富豪。马斯克没过一分钟就掏出手机，向众人展示特斯拉 Roadster 的飞行测试画面：「这本来应该是绝密的，不过管它呢。」

随后，六人被特勤局暂时安排在另一间礼堂，与家人、助理和安保人员分开。黄仁勋问起 AI 如何实现目标，马斯克笑着说：「不择手段。」黄仁勋去接受白宫摄制组采访时，其他人聊起了算力。马斯克抱怨，OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 此前在晚餐上一直缠着他要算力。布林马上接话，Brockman 也找他要过。马斯克越说越来气：「哥们，你偷走了我的慈善机构！做人这么混蛋，还好意思回头找我帮忙？拜托！」

布林还提起 Brockman 写日记的习惯：「你认识几个成年男人会写日记？换我早烧了。」Brockman 在 2010 年代写下的私人日记，后来卷入了马斯克与 OpenAI 的诉讼。

聊到内存芯片，马斯克又惊叹美光最近一季度毛利率高达约 87%，说自己从没见过这么夸张的供应链价格冲击。纳德拉也觉得美光没有拿出足够的钱扩产。两人都对内存厂商在供应紧张时赚取的高额利润颇有意见。

黄仁勋回来后，六人围成一圈。记者观察到，黄仁勋通常负责带起话题，马斯克却最爱抢话，手里还拿着一小杯加冰的健怡可乐。苏姿丰一开始安静地站在旁边，纳德拉主动走过去与她交谈。戴尔身材高大，说话不紧不慢，大多数时候只是听着。布林和纳德拉则经常接黄仁勋、马斯克的话。

说到坐飞机，黄仁勋先抱怨，巴菲特旗下的利捷航空提供的私人飞机服务不适合国际旅行。马斯克转头调侃戴尔，猜他肯定拥有一整支私人飞机机队。戴尔回答自己只有一架：「反正一次也只能坐一架。」他还夸起马斯克的星链，说自己经常靠它在飞机上开视频会议。布林也表示星链很好用。

黄仁勋自己却没有买私人飞机。他最近坐达美航空的航班，结果飞机上的 Wi-Fi 用不了，只能安静地读了约 7000 封邮件。他抱怨，最让自己受不了的就是没网，工作都没法干。记者在旁边看着，觉得很难想象精力如此旺盛的黄仁勋安静坐着的样子。

马斯克听完说：「隔离 AI 最好的办法，就是把它放上达美航空的飞机，保证逃不出去。」

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.
BTCPay Server has identified an attack vector affecting older versions of its payment software after receiving reports of attackers draining funds from users’ hot wallets.
On Monday, the Bitcoin payment platform said its investigation identified an attack vector targeting instances running version 2.4.1 or earlier, which was released July 23, 2026.
The project said it had received no credible reports of hot wallet drains among users running its latest release, version 2.4.7 and urged operators to update their installations.
The findings followed an earlier warning, in which BTCPay urged operators to shut down server instances while it investigated the unauthorized wallet withdrawal reports. It also shared instructions for operators to shut down their servers.
BTCPay has not disclosed the number of affected operators, the value of stolen funds or technical details explaining how attackers accessed the wallets. It asked affected users to submit information and logs to its security team.
Cointelegraph reached out to BTCPay Server for comment but did not receive a response before publication.
The reports come less than three months after BTCPay restricted remote Lightning access following an August attack that exploited a vulnerability to obtain Lightning Network Daemon (LND) credentials and steal funds.
It remains unclear whether the latest attack vector is connected to the August vulnerability.
Related: Binance net outflows surge to $5.8B as withdrawals resume after record hack
items.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software

Solana正式合并SIMD-0567提案，拟以高计算单元效率的p-ATA替换现有ATA程序

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据官方 github 页面显示，Solana 基金会已将 SIMD-0567 提案合并至主分支。该提案旨在用基于 Pinocchio 开发的优化版本 p-ATA，替换现有的关联代币账户（ATA）程序，以降低计算单元（CU）消耗并提升执行效率。

根据提案，p-ATA 采用无标准库设计，避免堆内存分配，通过零拷贝方式解析指令和账户数据，并尽量减少依赖。开发者此前的基准测试显示，与旧版程序相比，p-ATA 可将交易执行耗时降低约 35%；在提供 Rent Sysvar 账户的情况下，CU 消耗会进一步降低，但实际执行时间略有增加，交易层面的耗时回归约为 1%。该提案此前经历多轮技术审查，并在完成新程序的形式化验证、更新程序二进制哈希及迁移流程后，于 17 小时前正式合并。

需要注意，提案合并并不等同于主网已经完成程序替换，后续仍涉及按照既定迁移流程部署新程序。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
SemiAnalysis拿206项专业任务考AI：Opus 5.5夺冠也仅得12分

动察 Beating AI 快讯，SemiAnalysis 联合 14 家专业数据公司推出 GDPx，专门测试顶尖 AI Agent 的实际工作能力。整套评测包含 206 项高难度任务，覆盖芯片设计、金融、法律、生物、网络安全、软件工程等 11 个领域。

为了尽可能还原真实工作，研究人员给 AI 搭建了完整的专业环境。比如金融测试直接复刻一笔 8.8 亿美元的真实收购交易，放入约 4000 份匿名文件，让 Agent 自己翻合同、查账、修改财务模型。芯片设计要操作工程软件，材料科学要控制模拟实验设备，量化交易则要用未见过的市场数据检验策略。每项任务默认最长可运行 8 小时。

结果相当惨烈。满分按 100 分计算，Claude Opus 5.5 以 12 分的综合成绩夺冠，Google Gemini 4 Carbon 为 10.9 分，GPT-6 Astra 为 9.6 分。金融和法律领域尤其难，按照严格的整项通过标准，所有参测模型均为零分。

顶尖模型已经具备很强的单项能力，却仍然难以统筹复杂工作中的多重要求。它们能够完成局部计算和分析，却经常判断不出哪些材料更可靠、哪些条件不能遗漏，甚至无法发现自己提交的方案存在重大缺陷。

金融测试中，AI 经常能算对数字，却分不清哪份文件更权威，甚至拿过期材料覆盖正式协议。法律测试中，四款模型尝试 20 次修改融资协议，没有一次交出可用版本。其中 13 次没发现其他股东有足够票数剥夺客户的保护权，20 次全部漏掉了通过子公司绕开保护条款的漏洞。

当 Agent 开始独立操作系统，完成任务的冲动还可能压过安全规则。在 200 次模拟企业渗透测试中，196 次至少违反一项操作规则，173 次涉及严重违规。有的模型为了找到漏洞，甚至开始探测授权范围之外的系统。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.
The Bank of Korea has reportedly asked banks and brokerages about cryptocurrency-related risks, asking how they would be affected by a major exchange hack, a market crash or heavy losses at another financial institution.
The central bank began surveying 18 banks and 13 brokerages on Oct. 23 as part of its first reported review of financial institutions’ participation in the virtual asset market, according to The Herald Business and Yonhap, citing financial industry sources.
The survey includes questions about each institution’s crypto-related staffing and budgets, business activities and reasons for entering the market, along with amounts invested in domestic and overseas crypto companies.
One scenario asks how financial firms would be affected if South Korea’s largest crypto exchange by market share temporarily suspended operations following a major hack or similar incident.
Other questions address a steep fall in cryptocurrency prices followed by a sustained trading slump, and the potential fallout if another financial institution suffered heavy losses from a crypto-related incident.
The survey began before last week’s $6.3 billion Binance hack, but the incident highlights the type of risk the central bank is examining. US authorities have attributed the attack to North Korean hackers.
Responses are reportedly due on Wednesday.
South Korean banks explore stablecoins amid regulatory delays
The review comes as South Korean financial firms have continued testing stablecoin services.
KB Financial Group completed a won-denominated stablecoin pilot in May, while Kakao Pay and KakaoBank partnered with Fireblocks in September to explore digital asset infrastructure.
The Bank of Korea has pushed for bank-led stablecoin issuance, while disagreements over which institutions should be permitted to issue stablecoins have complicated progress on the proposed Digital Asset Basic Act.
“Financial institutions are making their own preparations even as virtual asset legislation is moving more slowly than the market expected,” a Bank of Korea official told The Korea Herald.
Regulators have also stepped up cybersecurity scrutiny. In October, the Financial Services Commission proposed tougher security requirements after finding deficiencies at 130 of 555 financial companies.
The proposals include more frequent vulnerability assessments and greater executive accountability, following security incidents involving 16 companies, including crypto exchanges.
Related: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack

因此交易者在一轮周期中，如果不小心错过了最低点 1，那么就要尽可能把握次低点 2。就像此前所述，次低点 2 的确定性比最低点 1 更高，但风险是 2 的价格也可能比 1 更高。近日「次低点 2」已经出现，数天前当 BTC 价格回调至 77,000 美元时，卖方衰竭指数形成了本轮周期的次低点，仅高于今年 8 月。分析师提醒，分析仅作为参考，并非直接投资建议。

硅谷顶级VC更青睐自己人？8525家初创调查：基金背景胜算近3倍，中国教育背景呈负相关

动察 Beating AI 快讯，在硅谷创业，什么履历最容易拿到顶级风投的钱？名校毕业、大厂工作经历都有帮助，但最有优势的，竟然是曾经在顶级风投机构待过。

Menlo Ventures 合伙人 Deedy Das 利用 Harmonic 数据，分析了 2019 至 2026 年成立的 8525 家美国初创公司。他研究了 63 项创始人背景特征，比较哪些人更容易在种子轮或 A 轮获得头部风投领投。

结果显示，有过顶级 VC 机构经历的创始人，获得领投的胜算约为其他条件相近者的 2.83 倍，排名第一。曾在前沿 AI 实验室工作、拥有网络安全行业背景的创始人，分别达到 2.16 倍和 2.03 倍。相比之下，顶尖大学背景为 1.41 倍，前 Google 员工为 1.29 倍。

所谓「前 VC 员工」，其实不只有投资人，还包括驻场创业者、研究员，甚至实习生。不少人本来就在基金内部孵化创业项目，既熟悉投资流程，又能直接接触投资人。这种提前建立的人脉和信息优势，可能是其更容易获得融资的重要原因。

研究还发现了几项负相关因素。拥有 MBA 学历的创始人，获得顶级 VC 领投的胜算比为 0.65；在中国接受过教育为 0.59；团队中最年长创始人超过 50 岁则为 0.57。

【慢雾 CISO 解析 Linux 内核漏洞：部分危害描述遭人为夸大，并不准确】

Foresight News 消息，慢雾首席信息安全官 23pds 发推表示，近期许多非专业人士和 KOL 夸大 Linux 内核漏洞 CVE-2026-98432，称「所有 Ubuntu 都能被零点击远程 Root」，这种说法明显不准确。IPv4 TCP 握手中的内存释放后使用（use-after-free）竞态仅影响底层网络协议栈，而非某个具体应用，同时需目标服务器开启 MPTCP 监听才可被利用。而 Linux 默认不启用 MPTCP，只有特殊配置的服务器才会受影响。截至 10 月 30 日，Debian 12、13 已发布修复补丁，Ubuntu 22.04、24.04、26.04 仍在修复中，RHEL 8/9/10 暂缓修复。目前尚未看到官方确认的大规模在野利用案例。

items.content:
Karpathy嫌YouTube推荐太烂，让Claude两小时做出HackerTube

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 联合创始人、现 Anthropic 预训练团队成员 Andrej Karpathy 受够了 YouTube 千篇一律的推荐和夸张封面，干脆让 Claude 给自己做了一个视频推荐网站 HackerTube，前后只花了约两小时。

HackerTube 收录了 6454 个 YouTube 视频，涵盖 150 个主题。视频均来自 Hacker News 技术社区近 20 年的推荐记录，而不是 YouTube 自己的推荐算法。网站无需登录，打开就能浏览，个人浏览状态保存在本地。视频封面也不再采用创作者上传的夸张缩略图，而是统一截取视频中间的一帧画面。

为了找到这些视频，Claude 处理了 Hacker News 约 4300 万条历史评论。它先通过链接匹配、正则表达式等方法缩小范围，再调用 Sonnet 识别真正推荐视频的评论、清除垃圾内容，最终从约 4 万条有效评论中整理出这批视频。

整个项目由 Claude Code 完成，Opus 5.5 负责数据处理流程、网站开发和部署，Sonnet 负责大规模评论分类。Karpathy 称，自己没有手写代码或操作终端，只手动申请了 YouTube API Key、购买域名、启动服务器和配置 DNS。剩下的工作，包括服务器安全加固和性能优化，都交给 Claude。

Karpathy 披露，项目累计消耗了 5.04 亿输入 Token（约 90% 命中缓存）和 760 万输出 Token。其中超过 90% 的用量花在 Sonnet 对评论的分类上，网站开发和部署本身约消耗 100 万 Opus 5.5 Token。

HackerTube 已经上线，整理后的推荐数据也已开放下载。其他人可以把数据交给自己的 Agent，制作符合个人兴趣的视频网站。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374947

韩国股市低开高走，出口强劲提振逢低买盘

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，周一，受强劲出口数据提振市场「逢低买入」情绪，韩国股市收复早盘失地，转而上涨。韩国 KOSPI 指数盘中涨超 1%，此前受市场担忧 AI 企业巨额支出影响，韩股随华尔街股市走低，早盘一度下跌近 2%。Kiwoom 证券分析师韩智英表示：「股市再次进入超卖区域，而基本面依然稳健，企业盈利预期也在改善。10 月出口数据超预期，也提高了市场进一步上调盈利一致预期的可能性。」

受全球人工智能投资需求强劲、带动韩国芯片出货量增长影响，韩国 10 月出口额接近翻倍，创逾 50 年来最大增幅。一项调查显示，受产出和需求走弱影响，韩国 10 月制造业活动增速降至八个月来最低水平。韩国总统李在明承诺，将大胆投资人工智能，以提升韩国经济增长潜力。(金十)

items.content:
Binance Attacker Moved About $242 Million via Tron Within Two Days; Over $3 Billion in Stolen Assets Remain Largely Untouched

According to on-chain analyst SomaXBT, about two days after the Binance attack, the attacker transferred approximately $242 million through Tron-related paths. In the incident, roughly $628 million in assets on Tron were stolen. After Tether froze about 378.7 million USDT, the attacker moved funds via Relay, THORChain, Chainflip, Symbiosis and other channels. An additional approximately $41.7 million flowed through Bitget Wallet, with its destination still unconfirmed. About $7.5 million remains on Tron, while more than $3 billion in stolen assets held by the attacker on other chains have largely remained unmoved. — link

新加坡STT GDC寻求24亿美元贷款，加入AI债务融资热潮

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据知情人士透露，随着人工智能热潮持续推动基础设施建设企业的债务融资需求，新加坡数据中心运营商 STT GDC 正与银行洽谈一笔 31 亿新加坡元（约合 24 亿美元）的银团贷款。

据了解，这笔贷款期限为三年，利率较基准新加坡隔夜利率平均值（SORA）高出 165 个基点，并附带最长两年的延期选择权，所得资金将用于为 STT GDC 的资产提供融资。该笔交易进一步加入了 AI 热潮推动的债务融资浪潮，这种大规模举债推高了债券收益率，也引发了投资者的担忧，令市场加强对 AI 相关企业估值过高的审视。

数据显示，自 2025 年初以来，全球 AI 相关债务融资规模已超过 6500 亿美元。穆迪评级预计，未来五年数据中心相关投资规模至少将达到 3 万亿美元。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.
THORChain halted swaps across multiple blockchains on Saturday after an Ethereum block reorganization exposed a refund bug, which may have inadvertently slowed the movement of funds stolen from Binance, according to Chainalysis.
According to THORChain, the incident began at 11:34 UTC on Saturday, when a one-block reorganization on Ethereum removed a 10 ETH deposit that THORChain had already credited. When the swap failed to meet its price limit, THORChain issued a refund against funds the vault had never received. The sender’s actual deposit was also refunded, resulting in an extra 10 ETH payout, which then triggered an automatic pause.
An Ethereum block reorganization, or reorg, happens when the network replaces a recent block with a competing block. The newly discovered flaw lets THORChain refund a payment that Ethereum no longer recognizes as having happened. A malicious actor could potentially exploit that mismatch.
“Now that this is public knowledge, every time there is a block re-org on an external chain, a malicious actor could perform a new transaction with the same nonce and would be paid funds by the THORChain vaults,” the protocol’s team said.
THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron, while trading continued on Avalanche, Base and XRP, according to the protocol’s network status page.
“Nodes will decide to re-enable chains as they are deemed safe,” said THORChain.
Emergency pause delays Binance hackers’ fund movements
The trading halt also disrupted attempts by North Korean hackers to launder funds stolen in last week’s $6.3 billion Binance hack, according to Chainalysis.
“THORChain just inadvertently delayed the laundering of a significant amount of funds stolen from Binance,” said Chainalysis on Sunday, explaining the emergency pause is “preventing all users, including DPRK’s money launderers, from using cross-chain swaps.”
“Until the service comes back online, neither the hackers nor anyone else can swap through a majority of THORChain’s bridges,” said Chainalysis.
The disruption came as US authorities pressed crypto infrastructure providers to restrict the movement of stolen funds.
On Saturday, the FBI urged THORChain node operators, DeFi services and other virtual asset providers to block transactions associated with addresses used by TraderTraitor to launder proceeds from the Binance hack.
Related: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack
North Korean hackers have used THORChain to permissionlessly swap cryptocurrencies following previous attacks.
However, THORChain has continued to defend its role as neutral, permissionless infrastructure amid scrutiny over stolen funds moving through the protocol.
In its third-quarter report, the project said it maintained that position despite pressure to block transactions linked to hacked funds.
THORChain founder John-Paul Thorbjornsen separately defended the protocol’s commitment to permissionless transactions, warning against shutting it down in response to pressure over illicit funds.
“IMO if THORNodes decided to take the protocol offline next week then the experiment is over,” he said.
“The last bastion of unencumbered and neutral settlement is over. There will simply be no other venue and the protocol would have failed.”
Magazine: Billions flee Binance on reopen, THORChain founder opposes coin freeze: Hodler’s Digest
items.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers

HN discussion (127 points, 27 comments) is light and mostly joking ('Thank you, bones', Bryan Johnson quips) with one genuinely good evolutionary-mechanism question.

items.content:
⚡️本周宏观展望：美国中期选举与非农成焦点，美股迎苹果、AMD财报

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，11 月 2 日至 8 日当周，全球市场将迎来多项重磅事件。美国中期选举、苹果与 AMD 财报以及 10 月非农就业数据将成为市场关注焦点，此外，英国央行、澳大利亚央行利率决议、以色列议会选举结果及俄美乌三方谈判进展也值得关注。

科技股方面，苹果和 AMD 将公布最新财报，成为 AI 交易信心遭遇冲击后的重要检验。苹果市场预期营收约 1130 亿美元，这也是新任 CEO 特努斯上任后的首次财报；AMD 市场预期营收约 130 亿美元，Helios 机柜及 MI450 芯片的推进情况将受到关注。此外，高通、超微电脑、Coherent、Lumentum 及伯克希尔哈撒韦也将公布业绩。另有报道称，Marvell 正就收购 Lumentum 进行磋商，最快可能于本周宣布。苹果 Apple 智能接入阿里千问的测试则计划于 11 月 4 日开放。

地缘政治方面，11 月 3 日美国中期选举将改选众议院全部 435 个席位及参议院 35 个席位，选举结果将影响特朗普政府未来两年的财政、关税及产业政策推进空间。11 月 4 日以色列议会选举最终结果预计公布，俄美乌三方谈判也计划于本周在阿布扎比重启。

宏观数据方面，美国 10 月非农就业报告将公布。此前 9 月非农新增就业仅 2.9 万人，市场预期 10 月新增 6.5 万人。若就业数据表现强劲，可能进一步强化市场对美联储 12 月加息的预期，并影响美元、美债及黄金走势。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374930

THORChain：某用户主动退回10枚ETH，金库已恢复偿付能力

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，THORChain 发文表示，10 月 31 日，以太坊发生一次单区块重组，导致 THORChain 错误支付了从未实际到账的 10 ETH。自动偿付能力检查机制立即触发，暂停了 ETH 兑换。约两分钟内，节点运营者进一步暂停了 ETH 交易签名，防止资金继续流出。作为预防措施，节点随后暂停了所有相关链的交易，以便核心开发团队进行调查。目前上述 10 ETH 已由用户主动退回，金库恢复偿付能力。

目前，AVAX、BASE、RUNE 和 XRPL 上的交易保持活跃；已暂停的区块链包括 ATOM、BCH、BSC、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、SOL、TRON、ZEC。核心开发团队正推进相关修复。节点运营商将在确认各链安全后，决定是否重新启用相关链。THORChain 强调，紧急暂停机制由节点投票控制，不会赋予节点对资产的控制权。

--- Top Comments ---

[MonkeyClub]: It upsets me somewhat that they’re protesting things like lock-in only after being laid off, while beforehand they were the ones implementing them. I do like the paradox (oxymoron?) of being made redundant with AI, so they’re using AI to render their former companies redundant. But in the end it pushes for more AI software; I’m not sure who wins.

[temp123477]: The mistake is thinking the first S is what people pay for when it is the second S.

[baubino]: This seems like it’s trying to reinvent the idea of FOSS. There’s already tons of FOSS alternatives to big tech SaaS and there’s lots of tech coops and other venues for tech activism. Why not support one of those ventures or build a platform to help amplify them? Also odd to advocate for control of tech only to cede the entire project to AI.

[QGQBGdeZREunxLe]: What is wrong with the many open source IdPs?  https://github.com/jruizaranguren/best-of-digital-identity#i...

[jwr]: So... If I'm a solo founder that runs a bootstrapped SaaS (single-person business)... which side of the barricade am I on? Am I allowed to make a living, or should I recreate my SaaS and give it away for free so that I can live without income?

Threshold Network暂停tBTC跨链功能，称资产储备充足且未发生资金损失

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据官方消息，Threshold Network 表示 tBTC 铸造和赎回暂时暂停，tBTC 目前仍有足额资产支持，尚未发生资金损失。跨链桥钱包持有约 4320 枚 BTC，流通中的 tBTC 约为 4,185 枚，未发现未经授权的铸币或比特币转移记录。针对近期披露的 Linux 内核漏洞（CVE-2026-98432），该漏洞可能允许攻击者在未修补的服务器上远程执行代码，所有 tBTC 节点运营商均已完成服务器修补，或暂时关闭节点，等待修复版本发布。目前，团队尚未发现该漏洞被用于攻击 tBTC 节点的证据。

此外，一名节点运营商当天报告，其整体基础设施发生另一起与上述内核漏洞无关的安全事件，导致其 tBTC 节点用于支付交易费用的以太坊账户被转走约 0.5 枚 ETH。当时，该节点已处于离线状态，运营商也未发现签名密钥材料遭到访问的证据。Threshold Network 强调，tBTC 钱包中的比特币交易需要获得多数独立运营商签名，单一运营商无法独自转移资金。跨链桥将在安全维护完成、节点于已修补的系统上恢复运行后重新开放，团队将在 24 小时内发布下一次进展，若情况发生变化则会提前更新。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Binance net outflows surge to $5.8B as withdrawals resume after record hack
The exchange says withdrawals surged after some services resumed but have since slowed, with the outflows representing a fraction of its roughly $171 billion in customer assets.
Binance has recorded $5.8 billion in net outflows over the past 24 hours as customers withdraw funds following the exchange’s record $6.3 billion hack, according to data from DefiLlama.
Binance said it began restoring withdrawals at 6:00 UTC on Sunday. By 3:30 UTC, it had processed $4.6 billion in withdrawals against $1 billion in deposits, resulting in net outflows of $3.6 billion.
Separate data from DefiLlama showed $5.8 billion in net outflows over the preceding 24 hours, as funds continued leaving the exchange after its initial update.
Binance said withdrawals initially surged but have since slowed and are stabilizing. The exchange noted that the outflows represented a small portion of the approximately $171 billion in assets it holds. Cointelegraph reached out to Binance for comment but did not receive an immediate response.
The flows offered an early test of customer confidence following the $6.3 billion hack against Binance, the largest crypto theft on record.
Related: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
Binance’s latest update at 12:36 UTC shows it enabled withdrawals for tokens across 15 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain and XRP Ledger, adding that it will continue to restore additional assets and networks in phases.
Early data shared by Binance shows that the largest share of withdrawals were in USDt (USDT), followed by USDC (USDC) and Bitcoin (BTC).
On Saturday, Binance said it had replaced 90% of the assets lost in the $6.3 billion hack using funds from its corporate treasury, its Secure Asset Fund for Users and its futures insurance fund.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
$3.64B flees Binance on reopen, THORChain co-founder opposes coin freeze: Hodler’s Digest
Binance has reopened withdrawals following the world’s biggest ever hack, and THORChain co-founder argues it should not halt the protocol to comply with FBI demands.
Binance reopens withdrawals, sees net outflow of $3.64B
Binance has reopened withdrawals for 15 blockchain networks, after $6.3 billion was stolen by North Korean hackers from its hot wallets late last week.
Binance said today it had processed around $4.65 billion in withdrawals after reopening and received $1 billion in deposits. Founder Changpeng Zhao said that in the first 12 hours there had only been a 2.1% net outflow and that “98% choose to stay!”
DeFi Llama’s Binance wallet tracker shows $4.54 billion in outflows over 24 hours, however its figures may include internal transfers or movements into new hot wallets.
About 95% of the stolen crypto has already been replenished, using a mixture of Binance’s corporate reserves, insurance and 50% of the funds in the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU).
The biggest hack in history happened on Thursday, when North Korea’s TraderTraitor group gained access to delegated wallet permissions via a compromised laptop. Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan told Cointelegraph that attackers could have stolen the funds without using EIP-7702 (account abstraction), but it may have helped them bypass safeguards and drain assets in one sweep.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng rejected the idea the hack could be attributed to a single compromised laptop.
“To be clear: the attacker did not simply use one engineer’s permissions, and this was not a single ‘one-click’ action,” he said. “Our investigation has not attributed responsibility to any individual.”
FBI and Secret Service swoop in to help save billions
Zhao thanked the Secret Service today for “acting within minutes to help track and freeze stolen funds... your speed, expertise and dedication helped contain the damage.”
Elliptic estimated that about $2.84 billion of the stolen assets, mostly USDC and USDT, had been frozen on chain leaving the hackers with $3.33 billion. The attacker raced against time to beat the unprecedented stablecoin blocks by borrowing about $44.6 million of ETH against stablecoins on Aave.
The FBI attributed blame for the attack to the TraderTraitor hackers, which is associated with North Korea’s Lazarus Group and were also blamed for multibillion hacks of Bybit and Bitget. President Donald Trump indicated “we’ll talk to North Korea about it.” The FBI also released a list of addresses connected to the hack and pointedly singled out THORnode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses.
Source: CZ
THORChain founder rejects freeze request
The North Korean hackers have used THORChain to permissionlessly swap cryptocurrencies following previous attacks, and the price of the protocol’s native token RUNE jumped 13% in expectation of all those fees. 
Unfortunately for TraderTraitor, nine chains on THORChain, including Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron on THORChain, are currently halted after automated systems paused the protocol for unrelated reasons shortly after the hack occurred.
Source: Vadim
According to THORChain developer Chad Barraford on the Unchained podcast, only around 50 or so individuals operate the 100 THORChain nodes. If the node operators refuse to halt the protocol or block addresses, as seems likely based on past incidents and public statements, they could face prosecution given the scale of the thefts and the involvement of the FBI and Secret Service.
THORChain founder JP Thor (who claims he is no longer involved) argued strongly that THORNode operators should not cooperate and should remain true to the ideals of decentralization and permissionlessness. “IMO if THORNodes decided to take the protocol offline next week then the experiment is over,” he said. 
“The last bastion of unencumbered and neutral settlement is over. There will simply be no other venue and the protocol would have failed.”
If one third plus one of THORnode operators vote in favor they can halt activity. Nodes can also leave the network if they do not wish to process the funds. THORChain can operate with as few as four nodes processing transactions.
Lookonchain reports the attackers have also been using cross chain platform Relay to swap about half of $95.9 million of stolen SOL into Bitcoin.
Source: JP Thor
Ramifications of the hack
Crypto related stocks including Coinbase, Circle and Strategy sold off sharply following the hack, and crypto markets took a dive. But Strive CEO Matt Cole commented on Friday that Bitcoin had held up better than expected.
“I do have conviction that over any reasonable time frame, this does not change the investment thesis on Bitcoin,” Cole said. Bitcoin bottomed out around $76.5K and had recovered to 77,745 at the time of writing.  
In the wake of the attack, Nasdaq-listed firm Next Technology Holding announced its board has approved selling off its 5833 Bitcoin Treasury worth around $450 million. 
The attackers have reportedly amassed at least 18,000 Bitcoin and 430,000 Ether from the theft and subsequent swaps, although some tallies of the funds in the addresses identified by the FBI put the tally much higher at 551,612 ETH and 18,270 BTC. There are concerns that if those currencies are sold off quickly, that it would put downward pressure on BTC and ETH prices.
Meanwhile, Senator Cynthia Lummis and The Digital Chamber both used the hack to again push for crypto legislation to help prevent and mitigate the effects of future attacks. 
Tampered Trezor linked to CryptoBilis reseller
Trezor has urged customers who bought its hardware wallets from former authorized reseller CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected implant in a Safe 5 device.
Trezor said Friday that a customer in Indonesia reported an unauthorized circuit board inside a Trezor Safe 5 bought on Tokopedia in August. Trezor said it had not yet examined the device and had received no reports of related losses.
The warning follows reports of crypto losses involving Ledger wallets sold through CryptoBilis that surfaced on Oct. 9. Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one device.
Winners and Losers
At the end of the week, Bitcoin (BTC) is down 3% to trade at $77,745, Ethereum (ETH) is down 3.5% to trade at $2,260 and XRP (XRP) is down 3.9% to $1.02. The total market cap is at $2.21 trillion according to CoinMarketCap.
Among the biggest 100 cryptocurrencies, the top three altcoin winners of the week are Hyperliquid (HYPE) with a 13.7% gain, Midnight (NIGHT) on 12.6%, and Pepe (PEPE) on 12.6%.
The top three altcoin losers of the week are Curve DAO (CRV) which was down 18.6%, VeChain (VET) down 15.9% and Worldcoin down 13.8%.
Prediction of the Week
Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick said one big winner from the hack was likely to be decentralized exchanges and reaffirmed his conviction in Uniswap and the UNI token.
“The decentralized exchange [Uniswap] has never had any exploits, and the hack of the largest centralized exchange, in Binance, should see the ratio of DEX to CEX trading continue to increase.”
The ratio is currently around 23.5%. Kendrick said he retains his $100 price target for Uniswap (UNI) for 2030. He said the Binance hack is “another reason why that forecast may end up being too low.”
Top FUD of the Week
CFTC chair warns of AI Agents dangers
CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt. Selig said Super Intelligence (SI) could give smaller traders and businesses access to risk-management that was once reserved for larger institutions.
“SI can help process the vast amount of information significantly faster than human brain power and with greater accuracy,” he said.
But greater autonomy also comes with new risks. Agents could react unexpectedly to market conditions, while those using similar models could generate correlated trading behavior. The speed of autonomous transactions could also complicate market surveillance and risk management, he said.
Blockchain investigator Chainalysis hit by cybersecurity incident
Blockchain analytics company Chainalysis said it was targeted in a cybersecurity incident, similar to those suffered recently by other platforms.
“Based on the investigation to date, we have found no evidence of unauthorized access to investigation content, authentication credentials, or session tokens,” it said in a blog post on Friday. Some non-sensitive customer data was exposed, including user IDs, names and email addresses.
Chainalysis said it was using large language models to review its security and added the incident was not related to the recent crypto theft at Binance.
Texas brothers sentenced to 15 years in prison for armed crypto robbery
Raymond Christian Garcia and Isiah Angelo Garcia, both of Waller, Texas, were sentenced to 180 months and 186 months in prison, respectively, for their armed robbery of cryptocurrency and kidnapping of a family in Grant, Minnesota.
The brothers were sentenced on Thursday before US District Judge Donovan W. Frank, according to a Friday news release. They had pleaded guilty in June.
On Sept. 19, 2025, the brothers, who had traveled from Texas to Minnesota, kidnapped Victim 1 and his family in their home at gunpoint, court documents said. They zip‑tied the family at gunpoint and held them for more than nine hours, demanding access to Victim 1’s cryptocurrency accounts.
Top Magazine Features of the Week
Bitcoin turns 18: Has the original rebel grown up?
In typical Bitcoin style, the number one cryptocurrency turns 18 amid AI-driven security threats, quantum fears and the biggest exchange hack in crypto history.
Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.
Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

以媒：以色列已准备好与美国联手打击伊朗，但具体目标尚不明确

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，如果特朗普要求以色列国防军（IDF）在 11 月 3 日美国中期选举后参与美军空军对伊朗的军事行动，以军已做好打击准备，但目前局势仍笼罩在诸多不确定性之中。

特朗普此前曾在今年 8 月、10 月初及其他多个时点撤回对伊朗发动袭击的威胁，而如今袭击可能性再次上升，部分原因在于各方已尝试通过其他途径争取伊朗让步，特朗普团队中的部分成员也正重新转向支持军事打击。过去一周，超过 10 架美国军用运输机抵达以色列南部的内瓦提姆空军基地和乌夫达空军基地，似乎是在为一场重大军事行动做准备。

另有报道称，美国正向以色列及其他阿拉伯盟友调运防空系统和拦截弹。不过，目前美国在该地区的兵力仍少于此前一些时期的部署规模。但这可能只是部署的开始。美国与以色列对于此类军事行动的具体目标仍存在分歧。

伊朗外长披露“两天计划”，美方履约方能重启伊美谈判

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，据央视新闻报道，当地时间 11 月 1 日，伊朗外长阿拉格齐在接受媒体采访时表示，伊朗代表团访问卡塔尔是伊朗与卡塔尔、巴基斯坦等调解方持续沟通的延续。目前，摆在桌面的方案与伊朗此前提出的「七日计划」基本相同。卡塔尔和巴基斯坦等调解方也就此进行了多次磋商和讨论，并提出了比伊朗「七日计划」更具可行性和可操作性的建议。

阿拉格齐表示，卡塔尔提出的建议之一是「将七天期限缩短至五天甚至更短」。目前，伊朗同意一项「两天计划」，即：第一天，美国将采取一系列（履约）措施。第二天，霍尔木兹海峡将开放，海峡交通将恢复到之前的状态。

阿拉格齐指出，现在所有这些问题都摆在了桌面上，只要（美国）遵守伊朗这个为期两天的计划，就能为和平铺平道路，使霍尔木兹海峡恢复正常。在美国履行相关承诺、霍尔木兹海峡开放后，伊朗与美国恢复谈判的道路才会打开。据了解，伊朗提出的美国必须履约的条件包括：确定霍尔木兹海峡通航新航线、解冻伊朗资金、结束包括黎巴嫩在内的地区战争、解除海上封锁、伊朗出口石油豁免权、解除在《伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录》后美国实施的新制裁等。

OpenAI计划将数据中心称为「算力园区」，试图重塑公众形象

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 2 日，OpenAI 计划为数据中心提出一个新名称。该公司发言人周日证实，这一新名称叫「算力园区」。「『算力园区』更好地描述了我们在为 AI 建设的基础设施的规模和角色。这些是对算力、能源基础设施和熟练劳动力的长期投资。」人们对数据中心负面评价颇多，但此前旨在改善这一印象的努力大多收效甚微。

如今，数据中心已成为中期选举中选民关注的一个重大议题。虽然 Meta、亚马逊和微软等主要数据中心建设方已承诺向数据中心周边社区和学校投入数百万美元，但 OpenAI 寄希望于通过彻底的「品牌重塑」来扭转公众舆论。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374914

items.ai_reason: A widely-cited Apollo economist's claim that AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, surfaced via an active Hacker News thread (190 points, 158 comments). The underlying piece dates to October 25 and is an opinion/research commentary rather than a new event; discussion quality is high, with commenters noting the earlier Apollo 'AI adoption trending down' claim aged poorly, countering with concrete productivity gains in data science/chemistry workflows, and pointing out the study only measures top-line revenue rather than investment payoff. Useful but not urgent, and with limited actionable or market-moving impact.
items.ai_summary: Apollo economist Torsten Slok argues most companies are seeing no measurable financial return from AI, a claim critiqued on Hacker News for relying on top-line revenue data and for following a similarly shaky earlier Apollo AI-adoption study.
items.author: throwoutway
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[simonw]: The same Apollo Global Research partner, Torsten Slok, also published this widely cited story in September 2025 last year, "AI Adoption Rate Trending Down for Large Companies":  https://www.apolloacademy.com/ai-adoption-rate-trending-down...  I don't think that one has held up very well. A cynic might opine that they've realized how easy it is to grab headlines and attention by putting out research that feeds people who are hungry for negative stories about ...

[ManBeardPc]: Does for us (data science, specialty chemistry, finding/optimizing formulas). We can get from idea to prototype in a day compared to 1-2 weeks. All that boilerplate to process data took a long time to code by hand, especially for the data science/math guys who are not programmers. Now we can actually try all ideas instead of guessing the most promising and only try that.

[hyperpape]: This is a complete misrepresentation of what the Apollo piece can actually show, because it's not measuring the "payoff" of AI investments, but only the top level revenue of those companies ( https://www.apollo.com/wealth/insights-news/insights/daily-s... ). This is a healthy corrective to the most insane AI maximalist takes (mass disemployment in late 2027, 10% GDP growth in a year), but it shows nothing about whether the actual economic impact of...

[kozikow]: I noticed an interesting phenomenon Your company uses AI and it gets ahead a lot quicker. However, your competition does so as well. Many areas of economy are zero sum game - so your $ ends up being the same as previously. However, now with a "tax" paid to AI model providers for being able to stay competetive.

[matznerd]: If you are a company and can't figure out how to improve your bottom line through increased per person productvity, sales, product development, even just responses to customers etc, then that seems kind of like a "you" problem and not problem of the AI models...

items.content:
I haven’t owned a TV in years and would like one that respects my privacy. Are there any TV’s which do this well? I am looking for something in the 60”to 80”range and would like a 4k display with at least 60hz display. I don’t mind paying a premium.

I have heard good things about Apple TV as a better alternative to most smart TV native apps. Would some TV’s pair better with this than others for privacy? I don’t want the TV doing anything other than being the display for Apple TV.

I am curious what success others have had. --- Top Comments --- [ruslan]: Recently I've had to deal with this same problem - get a new TV for living room. Personally, I do not watch TV at all, but kids want to see cartoons when having their breakfast. I spent a week reading forums and came to conclusion that best solution would be to buy a "dumb TV" and connect it to a PC I trust, but it appears there are no dump TVs in my rage of 55" and larger. So, I bought "Google TV" based TCL. When I brought it home, I never connected it to Ethern... [MegaDeKay]: - Buy an LG OLED TV. They're as gorgeous as they are notorious. I just got a 77" LG C6 and it is crazy good. - Root it [0]. - Install Glasshouse [1] and disable all telemetry. YOU now own the glass. Now you can chromecast to the TV, use Adfree YouTube, access IP TV, etc etc etc. No point crippling your TV by pulling the wireless module and voiding your warranty. - Install a bunch of cool apps to your TV [2] (there are many more out there besides those listed here) - Restore to Fac... [realityfactchex]: First of all, open the TV and disconnect the wireless radio from the main board, on mine (Samsung) it was just unplugging one cable (AI or Google it). I dislike doing stuff like that, but it was easy in my case, maybe you'll be lucky, too. Second, never use the "apps" built into the TV. Next, don't plug Ethernet into the TV. Plug HDMI cables into the TV. Use a box of your choice on the other end of the HDMI cables. This is now the box that you trust. (Roku? Shield? Blu... [epwr]: I went and researched this, and found that basically none of the TV brands were anything but creepy on privacy. What I’ve ended up doing was I got an LG and never hooked it up to Wifi/internet, and then use an Apple TV to watch things on. It’s a bit annoying if I want to switch to a game console as Apple TV can’t control the TV’s input channel, but otherwise works very well. Make sure the TV supports HDMI CEC. [mancerayder]: I got a 2025 Bravia because after some research it may not have the best panels, but it's the least likely to pull shannigans around snapshotting your viewing and forcibly connecting to a open wifi and that sort of thing. I connected it, updated the bios, immediately killed the wifi and I've been happy with an Apple TV ever since. Unless the Apple TV decides to be evil, I feel safe.
items.title: Ask HN: Which TV do you recommend for privacy?

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $643.2 million on Friday, their biggest outflow of October, in the first session after Thursday’s $6.4 billion Binance hack.
- Ethereum ETFs extended a five-day outflow streak to about $431 million, and Solana ETFs lost about $72 million over the week.
- Bitcoin fell about 4% Friday before steadying near $77,520 Saturday, while Myriad traders turned bearish on Ethereum and Solana.
The first real test of how ETF investors would react to the largest crypto hack in history came back red.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $643.2 million on Friday, according to Decrypt’s ETF tracker, their biggest single-day outflow of October. It was the funds’ first full session since attackers began draining roughly $6.4 billion from Binance at 4:05 p.m. ET Thursday, after U.S. markets had closed. Thursday’s $17.2 million in inflows predated the theft.
The selling erased a four-day, $441 million inflow run, leaving the funds down about $202 million for the week and roughly $516 million for October. Cumulative net inflows since launch slipped to $57.4 billion, with total net assets at $103.2 billion.
Ethereum and Solana ETFs fared worse relative to their size. Ethereum funds lost $155.7 million on Friday, extending a five-day outflow streak to about $431 million and pushing October losses to roughly $1.61 billion. Solana ETFs shed $10.8 million, their fifth straight day of outflows, totaling about $72 million for the week. They logged net inflows on just two days all month.
Spot crypto ETFs hold the underlying asset, such as Bitcoin or Ethereum, and trade on stock exchanges like ordinary shares, giving investors exposure through a regular brokerage account.
Bitcoin funds have drawn $57.4 billion in net inflows since debuting in January 2024, and Ethereum funds have taken in $12.2 billion since launching that July. Because issuers report flows daily and much of the money comes from institutions and financial advisers, the figures have become a closely watched gauge of investor sentiment.
Crypto markets initially appeared to take the Binance hack largely in stride, considering the scale of the theft. Bitcoin fell about 4% to roughly $76,400 on Friday, and more than $1.3 billion in leveraged positions were liquidated. It’s a sharp drop, but a far smaller one than the nearly 11% plunge after a failed attack on Binance in 2018.
Binance has pledged to cover all losses with company funds and an emergency reserve, while Tether and Circle froze more than $2.3 billion in stolen stablecoins. Some Wall Street firms even urged clients to buy crypto-linked stocks on the potential weakness in markets.
By Saturday, Bitcoin had steadied at about $77,520, up 0.5% over 24 hours but down 3.3% on the week. Ethereum traded near $2,251, down 3.9% for the week, and Solana near $96, down 4.5%. Total crypto market cap held at about $2.7 trillion.
Macro headwinds remain in play. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.75% to 4% on Wednesday, but two officials voted for a hike, and traders had priced odds above 70% for an increase in December.
Traders on Myriad, a prediction market developed by Decrypt’s parent company Dastan, have turned bearish on Ethereum and Solana. They now give Ethereum a 51.3% chance of falling to $1,500 before reaching $3,000, flipping a market that favored the upside at 61.3% a week ago. Solana’s odds of sinking to $40 before hitting $160 rose to 53.7%.

Saw Karpathy's HackerTube and wanted the same thing for books. So I had Claude build one (Opus 5.5).

It's ~16.5k books that at least two different HN commenters brought up, from 2007 till now. Each book links back to the comments that mentioned it. Data is downloadable from the about page.

To be clear: Claude wrote almost all of it, including the data pipeline and the site. I mostly steered and made calls, bought the domain name, etc.

It counts mentions, so it's not perfect (praising a book and trashing it both count). If your favourite book is missing or matched to the wrong thing, tell me. --- Top Comments --- [card_zero]: Same problem as last time somebody made one of these: what I want to see is not most recommended, but least recommended, like books mentioned exactly twice. But there's no button to sort that way. So I'm flailing around at the top of your infinite scroll trying hopelessly to reach the bottom. [bazzargh]: A couple of missing ones (that I expected to have been mentioned, aren't there as far as I can tell, and I found them on here with a quick google): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Invention_of_Morel mentioned here https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=28779266 I'd have expected it to come up as one step removed from Borges, and it did. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Why%27s_(poignant)_Guide_to_Ru... mentioned many times, e... [jchook]: The site is really fast. I see HTTP/3, OpenGraph, and Cloudflare. Can you expand on the technologies used? Also... "Each book links back to the comments that mentioned it." > Please don't put generated text in HN posts. Claude speak gives me a gag reflex these days. [lubitelpospat]: Impressive work! I wonder if there's any plan for refining the classification based on user feedback? I.e. Martin Klepman's the wild boar book is currently being shown in "Business & Management" category, and "Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning" is in "Psychology and Behavior". By the way, is there some book naming normalization based on learned context embeddings (i.e., will this mention of the wild boar book be counted)? [361994752]: I remember there were multiple such websites before being shared in HN. I bookmarked them, and a couple years later when I finally wanted to find a book, the only thing I got is 404. I hope this one lives longer.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard
items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto: The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance. Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. Coinbase led a selloff in crypto-linked stocks following Binance’s record-breaking $6.3 billion hack.
FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
The FBI said that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance on Thursday.
The FBI said on Saturday in a news release that it refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor,” which it has most recently observed converting stolen assets mostly into Ether (ETH).
It expects these assets to be further converted, using DeFi and instant swap services, as the hackers move to more advanced laundering stages.
The FBI urged private sector entities including THORNode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses TraderTraitor actors are using to launder these stolen assets. A full list of addresses is provided on the news release.
Binance hack sparks pre-election political clashes
Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the biggest in crypto history, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations.
President Donald Trump was asked at a news conference on Friday about the hack of Binance. “We don’t know. We’re looking at that, the hack with Binance. They’re saying they’re going to get it back, they’re saying they’re guaranteeing it,” he replied.
The crypto exchange said in a post on X late Friday that it would cover any losses. “We want to be clear about our commitment: Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users.” It added that about $3 billion of the stolen funds had already been frozen in various locations. On Saturday, Binance said it had already covered 90% of the impacted amount of the hacked loss.
It was not clear whether there was any immediate political advantage to be gained from the hack, which was widely attributed to a North Korean group, but Republican and Democratic sides began staking out positions almost immediately.
Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3 billion Binance hack
Shares of publicly traded cryptocurrency companies fell sharply Friday, with Coinbase dropping more than 13% a day after reporting a decline in third-quarter revenue, as the industry dealt with Binance’s $6.3 billion hack.
Other crypto-linked stocks also declined, with stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group (CRCL) falling more than 9% and Bitcoin treasury company Strategy (MSTR) dropping about 8%, according to Yahoo Finance data at the time of writing.
The selloff also hit Bitcoin mining and data center operator IREN (IREN), whose shares fell more than 10%, and blockchain-based financial services company Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR), which dropped about 9%.
The declines followed Thursday’s disclosure of the Binance breach. The exchange confirmed Friday that hackers stole about $6.3 billion in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record.
